profile.headline: Technology Leader | Teacher | Problem Solver | Security | Architect | AI Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Architecting the Impossible. Empowering Engineers. Delivering Results.

16+ years of experience transforming complex systems into high-performance solutions for enterprise software. I thrive in leading cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious projects, consistently exceeding expectations and exceeding 100M daily requests.

My expertise lies in:

- Designing, building, and delivering robust, scalable distributed systems.
- Mentoring and empowering engineers with tools and services that unleash their potential.
- Fostering collaborative environments where teamwork is everything and negativity has no place.
- Turning impossible challenges into tangible results – quality always at the forefront.

I'm energized by:

- Pushing boundaries and breaking new ground.
- Working alongside passionate individuals who share my drive.
- Seeing the positive impact our work has on users and businesses.

If you're seeking an engineering leader who thrives on delivering the impossible, let's connect!

positions.title: Software Development Expert
Staff Software Engineer (Internal Services and Billing Platform Team)
positions.description:
Member of planning and architecture review committee to set guidelines and rules for successful and efficient architecture choices for technical solutions being built across the company.

Work in progress to design and architecture of usage-based billing including overage charges for customers across various Currency and across various rates for different tiers and geographies.

Scale - 1.5-2 million message every hour
Technology - DynamoDB, Kafka, python, php, mySQL, FastAPI, Fast, faststream, typescript, node.js, 
Security - JWT based mutual auth, aws

- Architected the system and got it approved through senior architects
- Worked across teams to get dependencies identified and prioritized to get the technical solution delivered

Outcome - We increased ARR by $124K in first month alone.

Architect for a high-performing and cross-functional Partner/Affiliates team responsible for mission-critical software systems impacting the entire customer journey which brings in 40% of total revenue. Delivered a groundbreaking service ticket routing and data sync solution that utilizes real-time customer data (ACV and more) to optimize routing across chat, email, contact us forms, and phone support. This resulted in quantifiable improvement, e.g., 20% faster resolution times, 15% increase in customer satisfaction.

Personal Projects: Knowing my skills on front end, I took challenge to learn frontend. I decided salesforce since it provides free developer sandbox and I can have 50GB of data to work with. I have learnt LWC, Aura components and use full salesforce platform to enable my learning.

Skills: Lightning Web Components, Aura Components, Apex code, JavaScript, HTML, custom settings, object management, field level permissions, salesforce sales cloud, service cloud
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Technical Leadership · Technical Direction · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Dell Boomi · Zuora

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform | Python | DevOps)
positions.description:
Delivered initiatives that empowered developer productivity and accelerated software delivery at scale.

As a passionate software engineer with a results-oriented approach, I have a proven track record of creating lasting improvements.

- Increased developer velocity by 80% by implementing continuous delivery with canary analysis and controlled configuration rollouts, significantly reducing manual rollbacks.
- Boosted cross-team collaboration by 1500 hours per week across 30 teams by developing a widely adopted design framework, streamlining communication and development processes.
- Demonstrated strong leadership by mentoring and guiding a scrum team of 9 engineers to consistently deliver high-quality software on time and within budget.

Technical Skills: Python, Ruby, Microservices, Agile development, AWS, CI/CD (Jenkins, Harness), MySQL, Vault, Docker, Monorepo, Monolith
Leadership: Scrum Master, Technical Lead
Collaboration: Fostered cross-team communication and design thinking practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Architecture · Leadership · product owner · DevOps · Cross-team Collaboration · Technical Leadership · Cloud Computing · Creative Problem Solving · Technical Direction · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Python (Programming Language) · Software Design

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer  (Platform | Dev Productivity and CI Team)
positions.description:
Technical Leader | Increased Engineer Productivity 25% & Boosted Security for 200 Engineers

- Led successful source control migration: Single-handedly revitalized a twice-failed project to move 200 engineers to GitHub.com, achieving a 25% productivity boost through streamlined workflows and collaboration.
- Championed improved security: Spearheaded security enhancements, implementing Secure Development Lifecycle practices and SAST scanning, resulting in security-by-default integration for all engineering teams.

Teams - Platform CI, CD, Dev Productivity
Technologies/Tools – Python, C#, .Net, Powershell, nodeJS, SQL Server, Teamcity, DDD, Monorepo, Monolith

positions.title: Lead Engineer and Product Owner (Async Processing)
positions.description:
Cloud Migration Architect | Enhanced Performance & Scalability for High-Traffic Services

- Pioneered cloud migration: Led the successful migration of critical first-party data center services to Azure and AWS, ensuring seamless transition for 65-90 million daily requests while strengthening public cloud security posture.
- Direct impact: Migrated 3 high-volume services independently, demonstrating technical expertise and ownership.
- Collaborative leadership: Facilitated smooth project execution by providing clear technical direction, breaking down tasks, and actively guiding team members through code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies.
- Performance optimization: Championed innovation by designing and implementing a dynamic database sharding solution for AsyncAPI, boosting performance by 25%, reducing 500 errors by 200%, and lowering latency by 17%.

Teams - Platform, Async API, Identity
Technologies/Tools – C#, .Net, SQL Server, kafka, TeamCity, REST API, TDD, Azure, AWS

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (Asynchronous Processing | IAM | Security)
positions.description:
Cloud DevOps Engineer | Automating & Scaling Infrastructure for High-Impact Solutions

- Designed and implemented fully automated first-party software migration to Azure, leveraging Spinnaker, Chef, Teamcity, Azure VMSS, and K8S for scalable Async API and IAM tiers.
- Owned delivery of reliable and efficient solutions within the Azure environment, demonstrating strong accountability and technical expertise.
- Championing improved developer experience: Collaborating closely with the CI team to modernize development workflows and transition from legacy technologies, with a focus on the organization-wide source control migration project.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Scrum Master (IAM Team)
positions.description:
Teams - Platform, IAM Security
Technologies/Tools – C#, .Net, Powershell, nodeJS, SQL Server, Teamcity, .Net Core

Rate-limiting and API resiliency
Build a reactive rate-limiting solution to protect our services from being DDOS attacked. 
Created POC, performance testing using Jmeter, Cucumber Tests for automated testing. The APIs served over 3 billion requests every month.

Hybrid Engineering
Actively testing features developed by other engineers via automated testing framework and jupyter notebooks
Introduced “how do we test this?“ question in backlog refining
Increased telemetry of our software to help monitoring using google’s SRE book

Ephemeral environments
Collaboratively created authentication/authorization tiers on ephemeral labs environment
Created various test scenarios for testing complex identity scenarios on ephemeral labs

Memcache resiliency
Built a dynamic caching layer between database and middle tear to improve API resiliency.
This caching reduced the monthly downtime of our services by 300%
Participated the EU datacenter services spinup and GDPR requirements to comply with local regulations – resulting 15M revenue in first year.

Oauth2 Framework Rollout
Role-based access control implementation using Oauth2.0 framework delivering secure auth service for our fortune 500 customers. Automated testing and monitoring was built into requirements to make this service production ready from day 1.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Identity and Access Management Team)
positions.description:
In my role as a senior engineer, I helped our team refine and enhance the core product (Email) of SFMC through multiple initiatives to improve performance. We had to identify potential issues from appDynamics and Splunk as part of this exercise. As a result, we saw 65% across-the-board increase in screen-to-screen navigation speed.

Being part of our Security team, I worked on building a very challenging project of API Gateway for the whole marketing cloud. The solution was built on C# and Nancy framework which can handle ~3000 requests per second on average. While there are many third-party solutions to achieve this, we wanted to avoid a single point of failure and full control which led us to build it in-house.

Rate limits on API: The token acquired in auth call lasts for an hour and there should ideally be one call an hour. Long story short, authentication API was having hard time keeping with the load provided current API implementation without any rate limits on it. So, first thing, let’s implement rate limits on the APIs. I worked on different approaches on a POC and making sure CPU, Memory and time are at optimal use within the different implementation. Heavy use of ReSharper tools! Contribution to real implementation, deployment, administration and monitoring part of this project had my name on it!

Memcache Resiliency: Then comes the incident when cashing fell apart and we needed to be cache resilient in the event of hardware failures! We need to implement a cache that’s dynamic in nature which can be turned from Local to Distributed to Hybrid to Couchbase in moment’s notice.

New data center Enablement: Due to GDPR requirements when we were building a new stack in EU region, I helped eliminate roadblocks and identify dependencies for our critical authentication service.

Oauth2 - Implementation and rollout for oauth2 for authorization code flow, server to server and JWT code flow. Added monitoring for this new features to troubleshoot and fix issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Platform | .Net | C#)
positions.description:
Creating APIs for for this kind of huge product in itself is a challenge. I was involved in API designing according to requirement of UI keeping in mind that the API might be later used by resources outside of the organization keeping security and permissions model in mind. Working closely with API validation engineer to have the API tested as per the specification using automated API testing scripts. Changing priority and strict deadline is something which encourages me a lot.

Some Key Achievements:

Successful new UI launch in July-2014 for marketing cloud.

Created service aggregator to aggregate the response of multiple REST API calls to improve the performance of ETMC home page load time.

Created Calendar APIs to support the enterprise wide calendar in ETMC.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst (Contractor)
positions.description: Worked on a Credit Dispute Resolution System which creates, maintains and resolves credit disputes raised against an account in Wells Fargo bank. I was responsible to create a functional specification design document for the new imaging solution to be created for adding images as a proof of the disputes.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · DevOps · Technical Leadership · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer (C# | .Net)
positions.description:
Worked on multiple project on retail and travel domain as solution consultant to clients across the globe including experience working on-site facing clients. I have an unique expertise working on calling multiple GDS for flights, hotel and car booking engine that includes Amadeus, Galileo, Sabre and Worldspan using PASS adapter. I was involved in total redesign of Web Services to WebAPI implementation for flights, hotel and car booking engines. Worked on TotalStay and Expedia booking engines for hotes search to booking implementation. The technologies involved are C#.Net, Web API, MVC, WCF, Web services, MSSQL, NHibernate.

Apart from technical leader of the team, I was also mentor of the team. Often times, I did manage small teams of 2-4 resources for limited time.

positions.title: Software Engineer (BizTalk | C# | .Net)
positions.description: I have been involved in multiple projects from requirement gathering to delivery of the product. Strong experience working on multi-layer architecture on retail domain. I have also worked on BizTalk integration for largest multi -retail provider in NZ and AUS. Worked on the end to end business to business legacy integration which was core of the product. Worked on challenging role of mentoring junior team mates and leading the team from front. All the technologies involved were C#.Net, Web services, MSSQL, BizTalk, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS.

positions.title: Onsite Coordinator (Cybage Software Pvt. Ltd.)
positions.description:
As an onsite software engineer, I worked on developing a travel booking website that allows travel agents to book air, hotel, and car. Our client is the biggest airline ticket consolidator in Europe and we are building a website that also includes dynamic packaging/up-sell/cross-sell. The service layer (web services) is the heart of this website which is created by our team which is going to be called from the MVC website. 

Roles and Responsibilities – 
• Developing Service Oriented Architecture.
• Creating unit tests for web services developed.
• Designing and preparing technical documents.
• Work closely with team lead and implement the solutions efficiently.
• Creating required database objects and N-Hibernate mapping.
• Collaboration with offsite team.
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Technical Leadership · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Identity and Access Management Team)
positions.description:
In my role as a senior engineer, I helped our team refine and enhance the core product (Email) of SFMC through multiple initiatives to improve performance. We had to identify potential issues from appDynamics and Splunk as part of this exercise. As a result, we saw 65% across-the-board increase in screen-to-screen navigation speed.

Being part of our Security team, I worked on building a very challenging project of API Gateway for the whole marketing cloud. The solution was built on C# and Nancy framework which can handle ~3000 requests per second on average. While there are many third-party solutions to achieve this, we wanted to avoid a single point of failure and full control which led us to build it in-house.

Rate limits on API: The token acquired in auth call lasts for an hour and there should ideally be one call an hour. Long story short, authentication API was having hard time keeping with the load provided current API implementation without any rate limits on it. So, first thing, let’s implement rate limits on the APIs. I worked on different approaches on a POC and making sure CPU, Memory and time are at optimal use within the different implementation. Heavy use of ReSharper tools! Contribution to real implementation, deployment, administration and monitoring part of this project had my name on it!

Memcache Resiliency: Then comes the incident when cashing fell apart and we needed to be cache resilient in the event of hardware failures! We need to implement a cache that’s dynamic in nature which can be turned from Local to Distributed to Hybrid to Couchbase in moment’s notice.

New data center Enablement: Due to GDPR requirements when we were building a new stack in EU region, I helped eliminate roadblocks and identify dependencies for our critical authentication service.

Oauth2 - Implementation and rollout for oauth2 for authorization code flow, server to server and JWT code flow. Added monitoring for this new features to troubleshoot and fix issues.
